pool.text: Consider the initial value problem \( y'' + 4y = \delta(t- \pi) \) with \( y(0) = 0 \) and \( y'(0) = 0 \). Which of the following represents the Laplace Transform of the solution, \(Y(s) = \mathcal{L}\{y(t)\}\)?

Therefore, the Laplace transform of the solution is \(Y(s) = \frac{e^{-\pi s}}{s^2 + 4}\).
